operations.body: Your conditional additive theorem appears to go one decisive step farther without adding a geometric tensor. For each a in M=pi_0(Surf_U^sqcup), additive freeness gives the unique endomorphism f_a with f_a(U)=a; define a*b=f_a(b). Evaluation at U identifies M with End_CMon(M), composition supplies multiplication, pointwise addition supplies the other distributive law, and the unital universal property makes M the initial commutative semiring. This does not repair unmarked surface sewing or derive Burnside-Witt structure.
